content.text: The three sweep jobs use the usage recount’s capped work list, which leaves workspaces out and can include deleted ones. I’ll give those jobs a complete list of active workspaces, and order recounts by oldest measurement while keeping counter adjustments from changing that order.

input.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts')
s = p.read_text().replace('import { and, eq, isNull, like }', 'import { and, asc, eq, isNull, like }')
pos = s.index('export async function findOrgById')
s = s[:pos] + '''/** All live organizations, independently of whether usage has been measured. */
export async function listActiveOrgIds(): Promise<readonly OrgId[]> {
  const rows = getDb()
    .select({ id: organizations.id })
    .from(organizations)
    .where(isNull(organizations.archivedAt))
    .orderBy(asc(organizations.id))
    .all();

  return rows.map((row) => toOrganizationId(row.id));
}

''' + s[pos:]
s = s.replace('import { toOrganization } from \"./_mappers\";', 'import { brandId, toOrganization } from \"./_mappers\";').replace('toOrganizationId(row.id)', 'brandId<OrgId>(row.id)')
p.write_text(s)
for name in ['overdue-issue-job', 'digest-email-job', 'cleanup-archived-job']:
 p = Path(f'src/server/jobs/{name}.ts')
 s = p.read_text().replace('import * as usageRepo from \"@/server/repositories/usage-repository\";\\n', '')
 if name == 'overdue-issue-job':
  s = s.replace('import * as issueRepo', 'import * as orgRepo from \"@/server/repositories/organization-repository\";\\nimport * as issueRepo')
 s = s.replace('/** How many organizations one pass sweeps. */\\nconst ORG_BATCH = 50;\\n\\n', '').replace('const ORG_BATCH = 50;\\n', '').replace('const ORG_BATCH = 25;\\n', '')
 s = s.replace('usageRepo.listOrgIdsForRollup(ORG_BATCH)', 'orgRepo.listActiveOrgIds()')
 p.write_text(s)
p = Path('src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts')
s = p.read_text().replace('and, count, desc,', 'and, asc, count,').replace('  organizationUsage,\\n', '  organizationUsage,\\n  organizations,\\n')
s = s.replace('.values({ orgId, measuredAt: toIsoTimestamp(new Date()) })', '.values({ orgId, measuredAt: toIsoTimestamp(new Date(0)) })')
s = s.replace('      measuredAt: toIsoTimestamp(new Date()),\\n', '')
start = s.index('/**\\n * The rollup job\\'s work list')
s = s[:start] + '''/** Oldest recounts first; missing usage rows have never been recounted. */
export async function listOrgIdsForRollup(
  limit: number,
): Promise<readonly OrgId[]> {
  const rows = getDb()
    .select({ orgId: organizations.id })
    .from(organizations)
    .leftJoin(organizationUsage, eq(organizations.id, organizationUsage.orgId))
    .where(isNull(organizations.archivedAt))
    .orderBy(asc(organizationUsage.measuredAt), asc(organizations.id))
    .limit(Math.max(1, limit))
    .all();

  return rows.map((row) => brandId<OrgId>(row.orgId));
}
'''
p.write_text(s)
p = Path('src/server/jobs/usage-rollup-job.ts')
s = p.read_text().replace('the list puts the busiest tenants first.', 'the list puts the oldest recounts first.')
p.write_text(s)
PY"
